name: Residential

nadir.desc: The nadir view shows a large single-story residential structure with a multi-gabled roof situated on a sizable parcel of desert scrubland with scattered juniper and pinon trees throughout|A curved driveway connects the residence to a road to the south, looping around the front and side of the structure and providing a clear paved access route from the street|A rectangular water feature or pool is visible to the northwest of the main structure, surrounded by a small landscaped area|The property is set back significantly from the nearest road intersection, with open desert terrain on all sides beyond the immediate landscaped yard.

alpha.desc: The alpha view shows the front of the property from a distance, revealing a wide, open desert terrain with scattered conifer trees densely distributed across the parcel|The main structure and pool area are partially visible near the center of the parcel at distance|The density of trees across the front approach limits direct sightlines to the structure from the street, and the driveway path through the vegetation is the primary visible access corridor.

bravo.desc: The bravo view shows the property from the right side, with the main residence and adjacent green lawn area visible near the center of the parcel|Dense conifer trees surround the structure on all sides visible from this angle, limiting lateral approach and visibility|The pool or water feature is partially visible to the upper left of the structure in this view.

charlie.desc: The charlie view shows the rear of the property, which transitions into open desert scrubland with scattered conifer trees and no visible paved access routes along the rear perimeter|The structure is not prominently visible from this angle due to tree coverage and distance|No fencing, outbuildings, or secondary access points are identifiable along the rear boundary from this perspective.

delta.desc: The delta view shows the left side of the property with the main structure, a portion of the green lawn, and the pool or water feature visible near the upper center of the frame|The curved driveway is partially visible running along this side of the property|Dense conifer trees line the left perimeter of the parcel, limiting lateral access and sightlines from this direction.

considerations: The property is set back significantly from the nearest public road, with a single curved paved driveway as the primary access route to the residence. Dense conifer and scrub vegetation throughout the parcel limits sightlines to the structure from all approach directions and reduces visibility for aerial observation of the building footprint. The open desert terrain surrounding the property provides no physical barriers to off-road approach but the vegetation density near the structure may impede movement and staging for emergency vehicles beyond the driveway. Responders should plan for limited turnaround space near the structure and account for the extended driveway distance from the road.
clarifications: Does the driveway have a locked gate between the public road and the residence, and if so, what is the access code or key type? Are there any secondary or service access routes to the property beyond the visible curved driveway? What is the surface material and load-bearing suitability of the driveway for heavy emergency vehicles? Is the rectangular water feature a functioning pool with water available for firefighting operations? Are there any propane or other fuel storage tanks on the property not visible from the exterior?
